fields.name: Untitled
templates: Drums, bass (sidechained to the kick), chords, lead, reverb/delay buses, master limiter.
Drums, bass, keys, guitar and vocal audio tracks with vocal chain, plate reverb.
Strings, brass, choir and cinematic percussion with a large hall.

children.tooltip: Synthesized drum machine on the General MIDI percussion map (36 kick, 38 snare, 39 clap, 42/44/46 hats, 41-50 toms, 49 crash, 51 ride, ...).
Big low toms and long cymbals for orchestral percussion
Polyphonic subtractive synthesizer: 2 band-limited oscillators with unison, noise, resonant state-variable filter with envelope, amp envelope, LFO, mono/legato glide.
Saw plus sub square, mono with slight glide
Stereo feedback delay with tempo sync, ping-pong and band-limited repeats.
Waveshaping saturation and distortion with IIR oversampling against aliasing.
Feed-forward soft-knee compressor with stereo-linked detection, parallel mix and external sidechain input (for ducking, e.g. bass keyed by kick).
Duck against the kick of the sidechain source (low-passed key)
Noise gate with hysteresis and hold, or downward expander.
Lookahead brickwall limiter with optional 4x oversampled true-peak detection. Introduces latency equal to the lookahead (compensated automatically).
Six-band parametric equalizer: Butterworth high/low-pass (12-48 dB/oct), low and high shelf/peak bands and two fully parametric mid bands (RBJ biquads).
Resonant multimode state-variable filter with cutoff LFO; ideal for automated sweeps.
Convolution with an impulse response loaded from the project's media (device state key 'ir_asset_id').
Algorithmic reverb via a synthesized, frequency-dependent decaying impulse response and partitioned FFT convolution.
Trim gain, stereo width (mid/side), mono, channel swap, polarity and DC removal.
